nodes.label: Release workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds the apps from the tagged source into a DRAFT release so the maintainer reviews before publishing; automated builds are a prerequisite for future code signing.

nodes.label: REPO_URL placeholder
nodes.rationale: Template keeps repository links generic; the release workflow substitutes the real repository URL with sed so the notes work for any fork.

nodes.label: Code signing (SignPath Foundation / OSSign)
nodes.rationale: Not yet implemented; both signing services require that signed files come from the automated build, which is why releases are built in GitHub Actions.

nodes.label: Adding a UI language (i18n _MODULES)
nodes.rationale: Copy en.py, translate, register in _MODULES; tests verify no missing texts and matching {placeholders}.

nodes.label: AI disclosure
nodes.rationale: Most code written with Claude Code; maintainer owns idea, decisions, real-OBS testing and review; AI commits marked with Co-Authored-By.

nodes.label: Backup items (profiles, scene collections, settings, plugins, browser data, media)
nodes.norm_label: backup items (profiles, scene collections, settings, plugins, browser data, media)

nodes.label: Backups contain secrets (stream keys, obs-websocket password, browser logins)
nodes.norm_label: backups contain secrets (stream keys, obs-websocket password, browser logins)

nodes.label: Backup zip format (manifest.json, config/, media/)
nodes.rationale: Plain .zip so backups can be opened without the tool.

nodes.label: Optional media file backup and path rewriting
nodes.norm_label: optional media file backup and path rewriting
nodes.rationale: Missing media files are restored into a user-chosen folder and scene collections are rewritten to point there, making migration to a new PC easy.

nodes.label: Release process (set version, push matching tag)
nodes.norm_label: release process (set version, push matching tag)

nodes.label: PyInstaller Bootloader Exception
nodes.rationale: Allows linking/embedding the bootloader into programs distributed under any license.

nodes.label: Python runtime (PSF License)
nodes.rationale: Python-PSF.txt is taken at build time from the bundled Python because it lists the libraries of that exact Python build.

nodes.label: GNU Lesser General Public License v3
nodes.norm_label: gnu lesser general public license v3

nodes.label: Tag must match __version__ check
nodes.rationale: Prevents publishing a release whose tag disagrees with __version__ in src/obs_backup/__init__.py.

nodes.label: UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=only-system
nodes.rationale: Use the official Python from actions/setup-python, whose license is bundled in the app, rather than a uv-downloaded Python.

nodes.label: Privacy: no telemetry, no update check, no accounts
nodes.norm_label: privacy: no telemetry, no update check, no accounts

nodes.label: Safe restore
nodes.rationale: Restore is blocked while OBS runs because OBS writes its files on close and would overwrite the restore; current state is backed up before every restore.

nodes.label: LGPL right to use modified Qt/PySide6
nodes.norm_label: lgpl right to use modified qt/pyside6
nodes.rationale: Satisfied because the complete app source is public: users can install their own Qt/PySide6 build and run or rebuild the app.
